STG.Title: Tavern
STG.NoGM: No GM is online. The tables need a GM, you can still watch.
STG.Welcome: Pull up a chair. Open a table and play against a friend or one of the regulars.

tictactoe.name: Tic-tac-toe
tictactoe.guide: Hearken! Upon a board of nine fields ye set your marks in turn, and the cross goeth first. Whoso setteth three marks in a row, be it across, down or aslant, is the victor. Be every field filled and no row complete, ye share the honour.

fourinarow.name: Four in a row
fourinarow.guide: Mark well: cast thy disc into a column of thy choosing, and it falleth unto the lowest free place. Whoso first joineth four discs of their colour in a line, upright, flat or aslant, winneth the day. Red beginneth.

morris.name: Nine men's morris
morris.guide: Each of ye hath nine men. Place them upon the points in turn, then move them along the lines to a free neighbour. Who setteth three in a row hath built a mill and may take a man of the foe, yet none from a closed mill whilst others stand free. With but three men left, thy men may leap to any free point. Whoso hath fewer than three men, or cannot move, is beaten.

matches.name: The matchstick game
matches.guide: Fifteen matches lie upon the board. Each in turn taketh one, two or three, as they see fit. Whoso must take the last match hath lost, and the whole tavern shall mock them.

pig.name: Pig
pig.guide: Cast the die as oft as thy courage alloweth and gather its pips. Hold, and thy gathering is safe in thy purse. Yet should the die show but a single eye, all thou gathered this turn is lost. Whoso first reacheth the goal winneth.

ship.name: Ship, captain and crew
ship.guide: Thou hast three throws of five dice. First thou needest a six for the ship, then a five for the captain, then a four for the crew, and in this order alone. Once all are aboard, the two dice remaining are thy cargo: cast them anew whilst throws remain, or drop anchor and keep it. Without a crew thou bringest home nought. The richest cargo winneth.

liars.name: Liar's dice
liars.guide: Each of ye shaketh five dice beneath a cup and looketh only upon their own. In turn ye wager how many dice of one face lie upon the whole board, ever higher than the wager before: more dice, or as many of a greater face. Or cry "Liar!" Then all cups are lifted. Should the wager hold, the accuser loseth a die, else the liar. Who loseth their last die leaveth the game, the last with dice in hand is victor.

twentyone.name: Twenty-one
twentyone.guide: Ye play against the house, and Greta the innkeeper dealeth. Draw a card, or stand content with what thou holdest. Come nigher to one and twenty than the house, yet never beyond, and thou winnest. Aces count one or eleven, the courtly cards ten. The house must draw unto seventeen.

Table.newHint: Against a regular the game starts right away. Otherwise the table waits until somebody joins, and in the games for more players the host can invite regulars to the free seats. Twenty-one is always played against the house: pick a regular to play alone, or wait for others to join you.
Table.leaveConfirm: Leave the running game? It counts as lost. In the games for more players the others play on.

Config.title: Tavern settings
Config.gamesHint: Only these games can be chosen for a new table. Tables already running are played to the end.
Config.menuHint: The games on offer, the chat messages and the goal in Pig in one window. The gear in the tavern's title bar opens it too.

uiLanguage.name: Module language
uiLanguage.hint: Language of the tavern for you. Follow Foundry uses Foundry's language.

chatCards.name: Chat messages
chatCards.hint: Messages in the chat when somebody looks for an opponent and when a game ends.

pigGoal.name: Goal in Pig
pigGoal.hint: The score that wins a game of Pig.

breakOffer.name: Suggestion for the break
breakOffer.hint: When the GM pauses the game, the players see one suggested game with a button to join in, at most every ten minutes. The tavern window has a button for it too.

stakes.name: Stakes
stakes.hint: Lets players open tables of twenty-one and liar's dice with a stake in play money. Off by default, nothing changes at the tables until you switch it on.

stakeMoney.name: Money for stakes
stakeMoney.hint: The purse pays where the tavern knows it (D&D 5e, Pathfinder 2e and Crucible). Chips are kept by the tavern for every player and no character sheet is touched. Systems without a known purse always play with chips.
stakeMoney.auto: Purse of the character where known

chipsStart.name: Starting chips
chipsStart.hint: The chips every player begins with when playing for chips.

DEBUG.Title: Debug file
DEBUG.Hint: Saves one file for bug reports about all of Sephral’s modules in this world: versions, settings and what the modules recorded, such as the latest chat messages they read. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
DEBUG.Saved: Debug file {file} saved. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.

Intro.title: New at the tavern?
Intro.how: When the line under the title says it is your turn, click on the board or press a button. Everyone else watches.
Intro.tictactoe: Get three of your marks in a row before the other does.
Intro.fourinarow: Drop discs into the columns and line up four of your colour.
Intro.morris: Place nine men, then move them. Three in a row is a mill and takes a man.
Intro.matches: Take one to three matches in turn. Whoever takes the last match loses.
Intro.pig: Roll as often as you dare and hold to bank the points. A one loses the turn.
Intro.ship: Find a six, a five and a four, then keep the cargo of the other two dice.
Intro.liars: Bid how many dice of one face lie on the table, or call the last bid a lie.
Intro.twentyone: Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over.

Offer.title: A game for the break?
Offer.alone: One click and {name} sits down with you.
Offer.note: Your GM can turn these suggestions off.
